keyFindings.description: B5. escalateOrRetryUnconfirmedRoot cancels the registration deadline (1706) then awaits onRetry = resurrect; resurrectDeadTree re-probes (2967-2969); if that second list-panes fails for a non-PANE_GONE reason, probeLocator throws and only armRootRegistrationDeadline's .catch (1518) logs. Tree left active + unconfirmed, locator intact, launchFailures+1, no deadline re-armed; resync.probeActiveRoots skips unconfirmed trees, so nothing revisits the root until daemon restart or an architect exception. Newly reachable (pre-PR probe never threw); reproduced with a scripted runtime. Contradicts AGENTS.md's 'the controller and root registration deadlines log and retry instead of clearing anything'. Fix: try/catch around onRetry (or in retireUnconfirmedRoot), log, re-arm if treeStillUnconfirmed -- same shape as the stop-failure branch at 1800; or thread the already-taken verdict into resurrect so resurrectDeadTree does not re-probe. Regression test required (second probe throws -> locator intact, second deadline armed). Controller analogue self-heals via ensureController on every controller-bound effect; no change asked.

Land with B5: handleException (1986 ensureController, 1994 probe) is a probe caller the round-2 handling list omitted. On the core-NATS exception lane a probe/controllerAlive throw is pushed by events.ts track() (362-373) onto the pump's in-memory failures with no log and no redelivery (core NATS has no nak); surfaces only as an AggregateError from drain() at shutdown; a live root's reclaim-architect redeliver is lost. Silent failures sink is pre-existing; routing a plausible transient tmux fault into it is new, and probeLocator's doc ('a nak'd exception', 1876-1877) plus the AGENTS.md caller list describe a retry that does not exist on this lane. Fix: catch + console.error naming the role token in handleException (resync/onUndeliverable are the retry); reword the doc and AGENTS.md list.
